blocks.x: Agentic AI & Hyperautomation for Industrial Equipment & Machinery — digital workers, decision hubs and self-healing workflows — governed autonomy at enterprise scale applied to the industrial equipment & machinery operating unit of Manufacturing & Industrial.

Equipment makers pivot to outcome businesses: connected machines, service contracts and uptime guarantees replace box sales. The pivot is an engineering program — fleet connectivity, service intelligence and outcome pricing — built once, monetized for decades.

items: Field service scheduling by phone and spreadsheet; first-time-fix suffers.
Machines in the field lack telemetry; service is reactive and parts planning blind.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Digital Workforce & Multi-Agent Orchestration, Decision Intelligence Systems, Agentic Process Automation from the Agentic AI & Hyperautomation tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Fleet connectivity/OTA, Service dispatch and parts, Outcome/uptime contracts) on KYC Management System and EEMS Platform and Driisti Smart Vision Glasses. Governance inherits the sector frame — EU Machinery Regulation/CRA among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Hundreds of agents as one governed fleet — roles, queues, budgets and audit for the AI workforce.
Enterprise decisions in milliseconds — decision hubs with policy, evidence and replay built in.
Contracts, claims and invoices read end-to-end — extraction, validation and downstream action.
skills/parts/SLA routing for field service (first-time-fix up)
